title: Write or enrich a pattern after every task
description: When a task taught something (a bug, a fix, a decision, a trap), record it before closing the task.
root_cause: What is not written is lost at the next session, and the next agent starts from zero.
diagnosis_steps:
1. Search first (pattern 1): does a pattern already cover this?
2. If yes, enrich it: curl -s -X PATCH -H "Authorization: Bearer <KEY>" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"append":{"root_cause":"New cause found."}}' <BASE_URL>/api/v1/memory/<id>
   Or, if the problem happened again: POST <BASE_URL>/api/v1/memory/<id>/occurrence with {"note":"what was different"}
3. If no, create one: curl -s -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer <KEY>" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"title":"nginx 502 after reload","category":"incident","error_signature":"502 Bad Gateway","description":"What happens, when.","root_cause":"Why.","quick_fix":"Fastest safe fix.","tags":"nginx,502"}' <BASE_URL>/api/v1/memory
4. The answer gives the new id and similar patterns. If one covers the same subject, enrich it instead of keeping a duplicate.
A validated pattern is locked: propose changes to the owner.
quick_fix: Create or enrich one pattern per subject, in plain words, with the exact symptom so the next search finds it.
root_fix: If the pattern is validated (locked), create a new draft titled 'Proposed change to pattern N' that cites it. The owner merges or validates it.
